prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Charlotte for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what matters most to you (complexity of the case, nearby location, budget/insurance, sedation options, aesthetic result). I can’t name one single dentist as the universal best, but I can help you find the best match in Charlotte. Quick guidance and next steps:

What kind of clinician to seek
- For surgical placement: board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeons or periodontists usually have the most training and experience with implants.
- For the prosthetic (crown/bridge) portion: a restorative dentist or prosthodontist with implant experience is important for the final look and bite.
- Some solo practices or multidisciplinary implant centers do both surgical and restorative work in-house — good for coordination.

Qualifications and capabilities to look for
- Years and volume of implant experience (how many implants they place per year).
- Specialty training: MD/DDS/ DMD + residency (oral surgeon) or periodontology specialty / prosthodontics.
- Use of 3D imaging (CBCT), guided/surgical planning, and modern implant systems (Straumann, Nobel, etc.).
- Hospital affiliation or board certification (if applicable).
- Before/after photos and patient testimonials.

Questions to ask at a consult
- How many implant procedures have you done? Your success/complication rate?
- Who will do the surgery and who will restore the crown — same doctor or team?
- Do you use CBCT and digital planning? Will a surgical guide be used?
- What implant brand do you use and why?
- Sedation options, recovery timeline, and costs (including bone grafts/CBCT/crown).
- Do you offer a written warranty or follow-up care?

How to find and verify providers
- Search for oral surgeons, periodontists, and prosthodontists in Charlotte; check:
  - AAOMS.org (oral surgeons), AAP.org (periodontists), ACP.org (prosthodontists).
  - Reviews: Google, Healthgrades, Yelp, RealSelf (read multiple reviews and look for common themes).
  - State license lookup and any malpractice or disciplinary history.
- Ask your general dentist for a referral — they often know local specialists and collaboration quality.

If you want, I can:
- Find and list 3–5 highly rated implant specialists/clinics in Charlotte (I’ll include specialties, addresses, phone, and top patient-review highlights). Tell me your neighborhood, any insurance constraints, and whether you prefer an oral surgeon, periodontist, or a restorative/prosthodontist-led practice.
